verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents a first-party TurnDetector, an audio model that encodes user audio to capture what is said and how it is said. The docs say this model can predict that a user has more to say and wait for them to finish before responding, which goes beyond silence-based VAD and directly addresses talking over slow speakers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of turn-detector behavior, and documented configuration or tuning details (e.g., thresholds, how it combines with VAD timeouts).

support.subject: As a developer, I can use model-based end-of-turn detection beyond simple VAD silence timeouts so the agent doesn't talk over slow speakers

citations.quote: LiveKit's `TurnDetector` is an audio model that encodes user audio directly, capturing both _what_ is said and _how_ it's said.
A turn detector model can predict that they have more to say and wait for them to finish before responding.
